verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents official typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET. The JavaScript client has full TypeScript support across Node, browser, and edge runtimes, the Python client supports async with type hints, and there is a first-party Laravel Scout driver. Community reports confirm the SDKs exist and are used, though some lag in maturity. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, and consistent maturity across all SDKs (the .NET client was reported as alpha at 1.0, and the Rails gem fell out of sync with the server).
